seoTitle: Arlington ISD Calendar 2026-2027 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Arlington ISD Calendar 2026-2027 including elementary and secondary student calendar dates, first day, holidays, parent conferences, winter break, spring break, early dismissals, printable PDFs, ICS, and Google Calendar download.
calendarNotes: Arlington ISD starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 12, 2026 and ends on May 26, 2027. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 1, and Spring Break runs March 15-19. Arlington ISD publishes separate Elementary Student Academic Calendar and Secondary Student Academic Calendar PDFs for 2026-2027; this page merges the shared districtwide dates and notes grade-level differences. Elementary early dismissal is listed on December 18 and May 26. Secondary early dismissal is listed on December 17-18, May 25, and May 26.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Arlington ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Arlington ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Arlington ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does Arlington ISD have two 2026-2027 calendar PDFs?
calendarFaqs.a: Arlington ISD publishes separate Elementary Student Academic Calendar and Secondary Student Academic Calendar PDFs for 2026-2027. Most major dates are shared, but early dismissal dates differ by level.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the elementary and secondary Arlington ISD calendars combined on this page?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. This page combines duplicate shared dates from the elementary and secondary PDFs and keeps grade-level early dismissal differences visible.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Arlington ISD have Early College High School or A/B calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Arlington ISD also publishes a 2026-2027 Early College High School Student Academic Calendar and a 2026-2027 Student A/B Calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Are Arlington ISD bad weather make-up days confirmed holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Bad weather make-up days are conditional planning dates and may be used if Arlington ISD needs to recover instructional time.

customSections.label: Arlington ISD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The Arlington ISD 2026-2027 academic calendar is published as separate elementary and secondary student calendar PDFs. The calendars share the same first day, last day, major holidays, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, parent conference days, student holidays, and bad weather make-up days.

This MySchoolDates page combines duplicate shared dates into one Arlington ISD calendar reference and keeps the elementary and secondary differences visible where the official PDFs differ. Families should use this page for quick planning, then confirm the official elementary, secondary, A/B, or Early College High School calendar that applies to their student.

customSections.content: This page focuses on districtwide Arlington ISD calendar dates and published grade-level calendar differences. Families should confirm campus-level details with their assigned school before making final plans.

customSections.label: How We Verify Arlington ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Arlington ISD calendars page and published elementary and secondary student academic calendar PDFs, deduplicates shared districtwide dates, preserves grade-level differences such as early dismissal schedules, and compares major dates including first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, parent conference days, student holidays, and bad weather make-up days.

The official Arlington ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
